param_input_item.param_description: a string: zip archive destination file. '.zip' is added only when the name has no extension; any other extension (for example '.nlx' or '.fmu') is kept.
a character vector, a cell array of character vectors, or a string array: Names of files or folders to compress.
a character vector or string scalar: root path for the files to compress. Relative names in files are found and stored relative to rootdir, with or without a trailing '/'.

param_output_item.param_description: a cell array of character vectors containing the names of the files included in zip archive.

description.p: zip compress files and directories into zip archive.
Names can use the wildcards '*' (any characters) and '?' (one character).
An absolute name is stored relative to its parent folder: 'C:/data/a.txt' gives 'a.txt', and the folder 'C:/data' gives 'data/...' entries.
If an error occurs, the partial archive is deleted.
A folder adds its files and its empty subfolders; only empty folders get their own entry, and they are listed without a trailing '/'. A wildcard that matches a folder adds its contents.
Each entry keeps the modification time of its file.
Files larger than 4 GB and archives with more than 65535 entries are written in ZIP64 format.
Files are compressed one after the other and written in order.
Ctrl+C stops the compression and removes the partial archive.

history_item.history_description: '.zip' added to an archive name without extension, entry names relative to rootdir or to the parent folder of absolute names.
